title: Black Scorpion, Warg Rider and Ironbound Mimic
features: Slate-edged black scorpion with eight walking legs, two joined pincers and one rooted segmented stinger.
A goblin spearman seated on a grey warg; spear grip, reins, knees and saddle remain connected through movement and damage.
Dark oak and heavy iron chest mimic with front-only latch and rear-only hinges; closed idle/walk and an existing Adhesive Bite attack.
conceptNote: Scenario authored the three-creature concept. An OpenAI whole-sheet revision restored the missing goblin on one walking study; both original and selected concept are retained.
reviewNotes: An OpenAI background edit removed the opaque scorpion idle background without repainting anatomy. A fresh fully closed mimic idle sheet replaced an overactive first draft.
Complete authored rear damage corrections preserve the creatures’ rear orientation.
Runtime review uses real Adhesive Bite binding for Ironbound Mimic and joined rider/mount movement.
